title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Solo #12 (동심원·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Brazilian woman, an adult, in her mid 30s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface. Enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in twin-tail, real pores, real living eyes, 25 clicker rings piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum an anklet. Full body painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 52% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 30% and 71% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with jewel-toned scenework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both arms raised overhead framing her silhouette, belly and bust both fully displayed, confident direct gaze, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
